style_prompt: Architectural diagram. Hand-drawn line work, two-tone navy and rust on warm cream paper. Crisp legible labels in French. No photo realism, no people, no logos.
image_prompt: An editorial illustration of a single, well-engineered production line shown as the centrepiece, built once and clearly solid. The emphasis is on the reusable line itself rather than any single product. A sense of front-loaded investment paying back across many outputs. Muted Alberta cream base with deep navy line work and small rust accents, archival print quality, no text, no logos. All text labels in Canadian French. Match the composition of the source image exactly; only the text labels change.
